title: Numbered-repeat shimmer drift does not establish incremental cross-cohort Parkinson voice classification
abstract: A numbered-repeat log-shimmer contrast did not establish added Parkinson classification value beyond averaged acoustic measures and marginal repeat variability: source speaker-CV log-loss gain -0.029976; frozen second-cohort gain 0.013124 nats/speaker, joint bootstrap95% interval [-0.045884,0.127917]. Repeat-number chronology is unverified and both datasets were previously inspected. Source80 speakers(40cases),target32(24cases). Target baseline/augmented logloss 0.900174/0.887050,AUC 0.739583/0.750000. This negative incremental test is not clinical equivalence or a test of verified vocal fatigue.
